Whiskers the cartoon cat cheddar crackers
the cartoon cat detective at the station

Crisp sharp cheddar crackers cut into cat shapes, brushed with egg and sprinkled with smoked paprika, baked golden and served with a tomato relish. Pulse 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 100g plain flour and a pinch of salt in a processor until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes. Roll 4mm thick, cut into cat shapes and place on a lined tray. Brush with beaten egg and dust with smoked paprika. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Cool on the tray and serve with tomato relish.

M: Thick rib eye dry-brined, seared, finished at 200C to 54C, rested, with garlic butter and a loaded baked potato.
Movie world pepperoni and basil pizza
in the movies, every pizza is perfect

Thin cold-fermented crust with crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and crisp cupped pepperoni, blistered at full heat and finished with fresh basil and chilli honey. Mix 500g pizza flour, 325ml water, 2g dried yeast and 10g salt, knead 5 minutes and refrigerate 24 hours. Divide into 4 balls and bring to room temperature for 2 hours. Heat the oven with a pizza stone or steel at the highest setting for 45 minutes. Stretch each base thin, spread with crushed tomato, 70g torn mozzarella and pepperoni. Bake 6 to 7 minutes. Finish with basil and a drizzle of honey warmed with chilli flakes.
W: Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge (dark chocolate, cream, golden syrup), whipped cream, salted peanuts and a cherry.
K: the kid in the cinema seat

Vanilla ice cream blended with cold milk, cocoa and malted milk powder into a thick shake, topped with whipped cream and crushed malt balls. Add 500ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa powder and 4 tbsp malted milk powder to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Top with whipped cream and a handful of crushed chocolate malt balls. Serve with wide straws and long spoons.

s.note: Brown butter popcorn in striped paper bags
s.how: Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty. Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with the brown butter and flaky salt and fill striped paper bags.

s.note: Hot potato knishes with yellow mustard.
s.how: Boil 4 large potatoes and mash with 1 onion fried soft in 30g butter, salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 8, put a mound of potato on each, fold up and pinch closed. Brush with 1 beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve hot with yellow mustard.

m.note: Thick rib eye with garlic butter and a loaded baked potato
m.how: Dry-brine 2 thick rib eyes overnight. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for an hour. Sear the steaks, finish at 200C to 54C inside and rest. Top with 60g garlic butter, slice to share and load the potatoes with sour cream and 150g crispy bacon.

w.note: Hot fudge sundaes with salted peanuts and a cherry
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150ml cream and 2 tbsp golden syrup. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four bowls, pour over the hot fudge and top with whipped cream, a handful of salted peanuts and a cherry.
